lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense, semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The blobs are organized in roughly six distinguishable horizontal rows, with the largest and most intense centroids located along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible anchor nodes, particularly prominent in the region directly posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and middle flank. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal-facing surface and significant shadow/low-intensity values on the ventral-facing underside.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed primarily across the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of small, irregular notches are visible along the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
